name: com.ragendom.promptmotion-lite
description: Free AI text-to-animation for Unity. Generate humanoid Mecanim FBX clips from text prompts right in the Editor. Activation is free: enter your email, get a 6-digit code, and unlock 5 lifetime generations — no purchase or account required. Cached prompts are free. Need more? PromptMotion (Standard) includes 50 generations/month and PromptMotion Pro adds 150/month plus a Pro animation toolset.
